title: Troubleshooting Tools

header.html: 5.5 Given a scenario, use the appropriate tool or protocol to solve networking issues: software tools (protocol analyzer; command line: ping, traceroute/tracert, nslookup, tcpdump, dig, netstat, ip/ifconfig/ipconfig, arp; Nmap; LLDP/CDP; speed tester); hardware tools (toner, cable tester, taps, Wi-Fi analyzer, visual fault locator); basic networking device commands (show mac-address-table, show route, show interface, show config, show arp, show vlan, show power)
the official CompTIA Network+ N10-009 exam objectives, version 4.0

html:
1Command-line tools

Tool Use
ping Tests reachability and round-trip time with ICMP echo
traceroute (Linux, macOS) / tracert (Windows) Shows each hop on the path and where it stops or slows
nslookup Queries DNS for a name (interactive or one-shot)
dig Detailed DNS queries (Linux, macOS): record types, which server answered
tcpdump Command-line packet capture (Linux)
netstat Shows connections, listening ports and statistics on the host
ip (Linux) / ifconfig (older Linux, macOS) / ipconfig (Windows) Shows or sets IP configuration: address, mask, gateway, ipconfig /all, /release, /renew, /flushdns
arp Shows or edits the ARP table (IP to MAC mappings)
Exam tip

. tracert = Windows, traceroute = Linux. ipconfig /release then /renew refreshes a DHCP lease. nslookup and dig test DNS only.

2Other software tools

Tool Use
Protocol analyzer (for example Wireshark) Captures and decodes packets for deep analysis
Nmap Discovers hosts and scans open ports and services
LLDP / CDP Neighbor discovery: LLDP is the open standard, CDP is Cisco's; shows which device and port is connected
Speed tester Measures throughput and latency to a test server

3Hardware tools

Tool Use
Toner (tone generator and probe) Traces a cable through walls and panels to find its other end
Cable tester Checks continuity, wire map, shorts, opens, miswires
Tap Copies traffic passively from a link (network tap) for monitoring
Wi-Fi analyzer Shows signal strength, channels and interference
Visual fault locator (VFL) A red laser that shows breaks and bad connectors in fiber

4Device commands (generic show commands)

Command Shows
show mac-address-table Which MAC addresses are learned on which switch ports
show route The routing table
show interface Status, speed, duplex, counters (CRC, runts, giants)
show config The running or startup configuration
show arp The ARP table
show vlan VLANs and port assignments
show power PoE power budget and consumption
Exam tip

. "Which switch port is this MAC on?" = show mac-address-table. "Is the PoE budget used up?" = show power. "Interface errors" = show interface.

Exam tip

. tracert is Windows, traceroute is Linux; nslookup and dig test DNS; show interface shows error counters.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A technician needs to see each router hop between a PC and a server on Windows. Which command should be used?

  • Atraceroute
  • Bnslookup
  • Cnetstat
  • Dtracert
Show the answer

Answer: D. Tracert is the Windows hop-by-hop tool.

S2A user can ping an IP address but not the hostname. Which tool helps test DNS?

  • Aarp
  • Btcpdump
  • Ctracert
  • Dnslookup
Show the answer

Answer: D. nslookup queries DNS directly.

S3An administrator needs to find which switch port a device's MAC address is on. Which command fits?

  • Ashow route
  • Bshow vlan
  • Cshow power
  • Dshow mac-address-table
Show the answer

Answer: D. The MAC address table maps MACs to ports.

S4A cable run is hidden in the wall and the other end must be found. Which tool helps?

  • AA visual fault locator
  • BA Wi-Fi analyzer
  • CA speed tester
  • DA toner and probe
Show the answer

Answer: D. Toner and probe trace copper cables.

S5An engineer wants to discover open ports and services on a server. Which tool fits?

  • ANmap
  • Bping
  • Cipconfig
  • Darp
Show the answer

Answer: A. Nmap scans hosts for open ports and services.

S6A technician wants to see which neighboring switch and port is connected to an interface. Which protocol helps?

  • ALLDP
  • BSNMP
  • CNTP
  • DDHCP
Show the answer

Answer: A. LLDP and CDP discover directly connected neighbors.

5.2 Recall questions

R1Which command renews a DHCP lease on Windows?

Show the answer

ipconfig /renew (after /release).

R2What does netstat show?

Show the answer

Connections, listening ports and statistics.

R3What does a visual fault locator find?

Show the answer

Breaks and bad connections in fiber.

R4Which command shows interface counters such as CRC errors?

Show the answer

show interface.

R5What is the open standard for neighbor discovery?

Show the answer

LLDP.

R6What does tcpdump do?

Show the answer

Captures packets from the command line.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Reachability ping, traceroute/tracert
DNS nslookup, dig
Host info ipconfig, ifconfig, ip, netstat, arp
Capture and scan protocol analyzer, tcpdump, Nmap
Hardware toner, cable tester, tap, Wi-Fi analyzer, visual fault locator
Device commands show mac-address-table, route, interface, config, arp, vlan, power
